title: file-pcap, file-pcapng: use names from the specs for packet lengths.
description:
Both the pcap and pcapng specs refer to the on-the-network length as the
"Original Packet Length" and the amount of data saved to the file as the
"Captured Packet Length".  Use those names in fields and expert infos,
and rename variables to match.
